entity: House 119th Congress, floor amendment votes on bills shut down to a record low
what_we_add: our measure: 14 of 118 roll-call-passed bills (12.7%) got an amendment roll call vs a 1995-2024 median of 60.8%
why: Bloomberg Government and the Rules Democrats report the same finding in the same direction: record closed rules, 84% of measures with no amendments allowed. No source measures it as amendment roll calls per passed bill against the 30-year median.
